n17de106cf9.headline: Let’s kill the green deal together, far-right leader urges EU’s conservatives
n17de106cf9.summary: Jordan Bardella, president of France's National Rally, is leading an effort to tear down the European green deal. He urged the EU's conservatives to kill the policy together.
n17de106cf9.why: The European Green Deal sets the EU's climate framework, which drives regulation and investment in energy, industry and transport across Europe.

n785479d5d1.headline: SSP Group Q1 sales up on strong travel demand
n785479d5d1.summary: SSP Group, which runs food outlets at airports and train stations, reported a 14% rise in first-quarter sales on robust travel demand. It left its full-year forecast unchanged.
n785479d5d1.why: SSP is a major operator of travel-hub food and retail concessions, so its sales track passenger traffic at airports and rail stations.

n3069279fab.headline: Report confirms Tinubu inherited ₦87.38trn debt
n3069279fab.summary: The Debt Management Office said President Bola Tinubu inherited N87.38 trillion in public debt when he took office in May 2023. It disputed media reports putting the figure at N21 trillion.
n3069279fab.why: The Debt Management Office manages Nigeria's public debt, and the size of the debt stock affects the country's borrowing costs and fiscal policy.

n788b8be86b.headline: Cabinet ministers face economic growth test for new policies
n788b8be86b.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer said economic growth must be hard-wired into government decisions. Cabinet ministers face a growth test for new policies.
n788b8be86b.why: The UK government's fiscal and growth policies shape gilt yields, sterling and business investment decisions.

naaa9aa1435.headline: New Ministry of Finance PS sets off truth bombs
naaa9aa1435.summary: Botswana's new Finance Permanent Secretary warned that the diamond industry is drying up while consumption continues. He asked whether the country would act now or wait until measures are imposed.
naaa9aa1435.why: Diamonds have long been a major source of Botswana's export and government revenues, so declines matter for its fiscal position.

n0e0fb3b1f5.headline: Diageo sells Guinness Ghana to long-term partner Castel Group
n0e0fb3b1f5.summary: Diageo is selling its stake in the publicly listed Guinness Ghana Breweries to French drinks group Castel for $81m. Castel is a long-term partner of the Ghanaian brewer.
n0e0fb3b1f5.why: Diageo is a global spirits and beer company, and divestments of local brewing stakes reshape its emerging-market portfolio.

impacts.name: Diageo
impacts.why: Diageo is selling its stake in Guinness Ghana Breweries to Castel for $81m.

n46ad873180.headline: European banks may find it tough to repeat strong end-of-year performance
n46ad873180.summary: European banks are expected to report a sharp rise in profits for the last quarter, helped by robust lending margins and strong investment banking revenue. Analysts warn falling interest rates will make it harder to beat forecasts this year.
n46ad873180.why: European banks are major lenders whose earnings depend on interest margins and investment banking, both sensitive to the rate cycle.

nf60ce50968.headline: Green Connection Calls for Affordable Electricity Amid Tariff Hearings
nf60ce50968.summary: South Africans continue to struggle with rising electricity costs as the National Energy Regulator of South Africa holds tariff hearings. Green Connection is calling for affordable power.
nf60ce50968.why: The National Energy Regulator of South Africa sets electricity tariffs, which affect household costs, industrial energy prices and utility revenues.

n0d15c712d1.headline: European banks may find it tough to repeat strong results
n0d15c712d1.summary: European banks are expected to report a sharp rise in profits for the final quarter of last year. Results were helped by robust lending margins and strong investment banking revenues, though repeating them may be hard.
n0d15c712d1.why: European banks are major lenders and investment banks whose earnings reflect interest margins and deal activity. Their results are a key read on the health of the eurozone financial sector.

nd97efdeedb.headline: Cedi regains grounds against dollar; one-dollar equals GH¢16.10
nd97efdeedb.summary: The cedi regained ground against the dollar, with one dollar at GH¢16.10. Analysts linked the stability to lower speculative demand, as the Bank of Ghana announced a US$170 million 7-day forward auction.
nd97efdeedb.why: The Bank of Ghana's FX auctions are its main tool for meeting dollar demand and managing the cedi's exchange rate, which affects importers and inflation.

n3234d34524.headline: Kejriwal Urges Centre To Enact Law Banning Loan Waivers For Corporates
n3234d34524.summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, calling for a nationwide law to prohibit loan waivers for billionaires. The request concerns corporate loan write-offs.
n3234d34524.why: Corporate loan waivers affect bank balance sheets and public-sector lenders, making bank-sector regulation a material policy issue in India.

n0575ccabbf.headline: A US shutdown on foreign aid is hitting from Africa to Asia to Ukraine. Here’s how. - The Boston Globe
n0575ccabbf.summary: The Trump administration ordered a pause on foreign aid to review thousands of humanitarian, development and security programmes. Affected programmes span Africa, Asia and Ukraine.
n0575ccabbf.why: Foreign aid flows support recipient-country budgets, health and infrastructure projects, and contractors and NGOs that depend on US funding. Changes in US aid policy can affect those economies and the firms that deliver the programmes.

ned71cbdffd.headline: Moroccan Producers Face Third Straight Year of Declining Production
ned71cbdffd.summary: Moroccan olive oil production is expected to fall to 90,000 metric tons, its third consecutive year of decline. Prices are rising rapidly and shortage fears are growing.
ned71cbdffd.why: Morocco is a significant global olive oil producer, so output shortfalls there can tighten supply and lift prices in edible oil markets worldwide.

na8b51427cb.headline: Middle East families to experience USD 1trn transfer of generational wealth by 2030
na8b51427cb.summary: Middle East families are expected to experience a USD 1 trillion transfer of generational wealth by 2030, according to a report presented by DIFC Innovation Hub, Julius Baer and Euroclear.
na8b51427cb.why: Generational wealth transfers shape demand for private banking, asset management and custody services, which are key businesses for wealth managers and financial market infrastructure providers.

n8dc38e79d7.headline: SAP sees higher operating profit, cloud revenue growth
n8dc38e79d7.summary: SAP, Europe's largest software maker, said it is more optimistic about its results this year. The company cited accelerating revenue growth from cloud computing.
n8dc38e79d7.why: SAP is Europe's largest enterprise software company, and its cloud business is a key indicator of corporate IT spending.
n8dc38e79d7.why_moved: SAP said it is more optimistic about this year's results, citing accelerating cloud revenue growth. Upgraded guidance typically reprices a stock on expected earnings.

nd57c998178.headline: Further Marginal Fall in Petrol Prices will do Little to Ease Motorists’ Pain
nd57c998178.summary: MOL will cut retail petrol prices by 3 forints and diesel by 4 forints at its filling stations from midnight, following a price change announced Monday.
nd57c998178.why: MOL is Hungary's largest oil and gas group, and its pump prices shape fuel costs across the country.

n0af4551447.headline: Selloff eases as China's DeepSeek triggers AI rethink
n0af4551447.summary: A selloff eased as Chinese startup DeepSeek launched a free AI assistant that it says uses less data, prompting a rethink on AI investment.
n0af4551447.why: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI developer, and cost-efficient models can shift expectations for spending on AI chips and cloud infrastructure.
n0af4551447.why_moved: The selloff eased after DeepSeek launched a free AI assistant it says uses less data. That raised questions about the cost of building advanced AI models.

n79d1347dbc.headline: EPP rejects Bardella’s proposal to temporarily suspend EU Green Deal
n79d1347dbc.summary: The European People's Party has rejected a proposal by Jordan Bardella to temporarily suspend the EU Green Deal. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk argued in Strasbourg that economic collapse would leave no one caring about the environment.
n79d1347dbc.why: The European Green Deal is the EU's climate framework, setting rules that affect energy, industry and investment across member states.

n7a6046d320.headline: Petition seeking to declare 2025 budget unconstitutional filed
n7a6046d320.summary: A petition was filed seeking to declare the 2025 General Appropriations Act unconstitutional. The act contains the proposed P6.325-trillion budget for the year.
n7a6046d320.why: The national budget sets government spending priorities and fiscal deficits, which influence Philippine growth, bond issuance and the peso.

n4f66b89019.headline: State sells more AIB shares and says it may exit bank this year
n4f66b89019.summary: The Irish State has cut its shareholding in AIB Group to 12.5%. It said it may fully exit the bank this year.
n4f66b89019.why: AIB is one of Ireland's largest retail banks, and the state has held a major stake since its 2008-2009 bailout.

n46be6f34b4.headline: AdGuard VPN review: a fast sleeper hit for internet privacy
n46be6f34b4.summary: Adviser Bashir has defended the government's move to increase VAT, saying that relying on direct taxes may be very good for the developed economy.
n46be6f34b4.why: Value-added tax changes affect consumer prices and government revenue, and shifts between indirect and direct taxes affect fiscal policy.

nbd63b337cb.headline: Gold boom at what cost?: How galamsey is crushing Ghana’s cocoa industry
nbd63b337cb.summary: Galamsey gold mining has reinforced Ghana's position as a leading African gold producer, but is crushing the country's cocoa industry, according to the report.
nbd63b337cb.why: Ghana is a major cocoa producer and a leading gold producer in Africa, so disruption to either sector matters for global commodity supply.

n15a3387168.headline: Rupee sees marginal decline against US dollar
n15a3387168.summary: The rupee settled at 278.93 against the US dollar in the inter-bank market, showing a marginal decline. The move was small.
n15a3387168.why: The rupee's exchange rate against the dollar affects Pakistan's import costs, inflation and foreign-currency debt servicing, which matter to investors in Pakistani assets.

na65e4ab973.headline: DeepSeek breakthrough raises AI energy questions
na65e4ab973.summary: Chinese startup DeepSeek's new chatbot has challenged assumptions about the cost of artificial intelligence across the tech sector. The article examines the energy questions this raises.
na65e4ab973.why: AI model efficiency drives demand for data centre power and chips, so changes in perceived AI training and running costs can reshape spending expectations for chipmakers and energy suppliers.

n42d845537f.headline: Pub chain with 300 locations warns price hikes are on their way very soon
n42d845537f.summary: The Shepherd Neame pub chain, with around 300 locations, has warned that the price of a pint will rise in its pubs and hotels very soon.
n42d845537f.why: Shepherd Neame is a UK brewer and pub operator, so its pricing decisions reflect beer costs and pressure in the UK hospitality sector.

n8d3831c4c4.headline: Egg prices are soaring. Don’t expect that to change anytime soon
n8d3831c4c4.summary: Bird flu is forcing US farmers to slaughter millions of chickens a month, pushing egg prices to more than double their summer 2023 level. Prices are not expected to fall soon.
n8d3831c4c4.why: Eggs are a staple food commodity, and outbreaks of avian influenza reduce poultry supply, feeding into consumer inflation and food-sector margins.

ncde35b3e8e.headline: URC Optimistic on Sales Despite High Agricultural Prices
ncde35b3e8e.summary: Universal Robina Corporation remains cautiously optimistic about profit growth despite high raw material prices. CEO Irwin Lee discussed inflation effects and investments to boost production.
ncde35b3e8e.why: Universal Robina is a major Philippine food and beverage company whose margins depend on agricultural input costs.

n4dfdc54859.headline: GM results aren
n4dfdc54859.summary: General Motors reported earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations, according to a Reuters report datelined Detroit. The input does not give further figures.
n4dfdc54859.why: General Motors is one of the largest US automakers, and its earnings indicate the health of the US auto sector and consumer vehicle demand.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: Earnings above Wall Street expectations are typically viewed positively by investors in the reporting company.

n4dfdc54859.why_moved: Earnings exceeded Wall Street expectations, a result that typically prompts investors to reassess the company's profit outlook.

ne01f26034e.headline: US bond investors seek safety amid uncertainty about Trump policies, Fed outlook
ne01f26034e.summary: US bond investors are preparing for increased volatility and staying defensive in their portfolios. The uncertainty concerns the impact of the Trump administration's policies and the Federal Reserve's outlook.
ne01f26034e.why: US Treasuries are the benchmark government bonds that price borrowing costs across global markets. Shifts in investor positioning there affect yields, equities and the dollar.

nd93336ff08.headline: RBI to inject another Rs 1.1 lakh crore to enhance liquidity in banking system
nd93336ff08.summary: The Reserve Bank of India said it will inject another Rs 1.1 lakh crore into the banking system to enhance liquidity. The step follows a review of current liquidity and financial conditions.
nd93336ff08.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank that manages liquidity and monetary conditions for India's banking system. Its liquidity operations influence short-term funding costs and credit flows.

nc3d26358fa.headline: Aurangzeb hints at tax reforms for Pakistan’s salaried group
nc3d26358fa.summary: Finance Minister Aurangzeb said tax slabs for Pakistan's salaried group need to be rethought. He did not commit to a specific change.
nc3d26358fa.why: Income tax slabs for salaried workers affect household disposable income and the government's revenue base. Changes are closely watched by investors in Pakistan's fiscal policy.

n491882f48f.headline: Bank of China announces 1 Trillion Yuan AI Industry investment
n491882f48f.summary: Bank of China is offering special comprehensive financial support to all types of entities across the AI industry chain. It announced an investment of 1 trillion yuan for the sector.
n491882f48f.why: Bank of China is one of China's largest state-owned commercial banks. Large lending programs can shape investment flows into strategic industries such as AI.

nd02464f527.headline: Retail investors bought record amount of Nvidia stock in DeepSeek rout
nd02464f527.summary: Retail investors bought a record amount of Nvidia stock on Monday after concerns over a low-cost AI model from Chinese startup DeepSeek cut 17% off its shares.
nd02464f527.why: Nvidia designs the graphics processors widely used to train and run artificial intelligence models, so its share price is a key gauge of investor sentiment toward AI spending.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Shares fell 17% after concerns over a low-cost Chinese AI model, and retail investors bought heavily into the drop.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nd02464f527.why_moved: Concerns that a low-cost AI model from DeepSeek could reduce demand for high-end chips weighed on Nvidia's shares, which fell 17% in the period described.

n345a7a7530.headline: Quebec legislature returns for spring session amid Trump tariff threat
n345a7a7530.summary: The Quebec legislature resumes sitting for a spring session likely to be dominated by the threat of a trade war with the United States, alongside secularism and identity debates.
n345a7a7530.why: Quebec is a major Canadian exporter, and trade tensions with the United States directly affect its manufacturing and resource sectors.

nebec6ba2df.headline: RBI Examines P2P Operations Post-New Lending Guidelines
nebec6ba2df.summary: The Reserve Bank of India asked peer-to-peer lending firms to furnish operational details, including cross-selling practices, under new norms.
nebec6ba2df.why: The RBI regulates India's financial system, and its P2P lending rules shape how non-bank lenders operate and compete with banks.

n537bef3682.headline: Supply of affordable, mid-income houses witnesses crisis in top 9 cities
n537bef3682.summary: Supply of affordable and mid-income homes in India's top nine cities has dropped 36% over the last two years, according to PropEquity data. Migrants move to these cities mainly for jobs.
n537bef3682.why: Housing supply in India's major cities shapes real estate developers' pipelines, mortgage lending and urban labour costs. Data from PropEquity is a widely cited gauge of the Indian residential market.

n72339e8322.headline: Oil prices hover near two-week low; weak China data adds to demand concerns
n72339e8322.summary: Oil prices hovered near a two-week low on Tuesday after weak economic data from China and warmer weather forecasts elsewhere weighed on the demand outlook.
n72339e8322.why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil, and China is the world's largest crude importer. Shifts in demand expectations feed directly into energy prices and related equities.
n72339e8322.why_moved: Weak economic data from China raised concerns about oil demand. Warmer weather forecasts elsewhere also reduced expected heating-fuel demand.

n5911aac8f0.headline: DeepSeek’s low-cost AI chatbot is a win for the whole industry, Northeastern expert says
n5911aac8f0.summary: Northeastern computer science professor David Bau says DeepSeek's low-cost AI chatbot is a positive development for the industry and will likely have a cascading effect.
n5911aac8f0.why: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI developer, and low-cost AI models can change pricing and competition for larger AI model providers and their chip suppliers.

n26c60f218e.headline: Industrialists decry 1% rate cut
n26c60f218e.summary: Industrialists in Pakistan decried a 1% rate cut, saying falling inflationary pressures gave room for a more aggressive 5% reduction.
n26c60f218e.why: Interest rate decisions by Pakistan's central bank influence borrowing costs, inflation expectations and the rupee, which matter for investors in Pakistani assets.

nc46e28dc35.headline: Below-expectation results drag down PSX
nc46e28dc35.summary: The KSE-100 index dipped 1,360 points as below-expectation company results weighed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange amid a global equity slump.
nc46e28dc35.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the largest listed companies in Pakistan.
nc46e28dc35.why_moved: The index fell amid a global equity slump, and the input also cites below-expectation results weighing on the exchange.

ne6baba7b59.headline: Who funds the World Health Organization? A list of its biggest donors
ne6baba7b59.summary: President Donald Trump's decision to exit the World Health Organization means the UN agency is losing its biggest funder, according to WJXT.
ne6baba7b59.why: The WHO is the UN's health agency, and its funding depends largely on voluntary contributions from member states and donors.

nf8724d0a67.headline: AI power stocks attempt rebound as DeepSeek release casts 'uncertainty' over industry
nf8724d0a67.summary: AI-exposed power stocks rebounded on Tuesday after being crushed the previous day in a tech rout that followed the release of a new AI model.
nf8724d0a67.why: AI data center growth raises electricity demand, which links AI infrastructure sentiment to power and utility shares.
nf8724d0a67.why_moved: Shares fell sharply in a tech rout after a new AI model was released, then partly rebounded, with the source citing uncertainty over the industry.

n61c6fe1839.headline: Perplexity AI proposes TikTok merger; part US government ownership
n61c6fe1839.summary: Perplexity AI has proposed a merger with TikTok that would give the US government a 50% ownership stake, a new proposal on the table for the video app.
n61c6fe1839.why: TikTok is a major short-video platform whose US ownership has been subject to government scrutiny, so any structural change affects advertising and data-regulation risk.

nbf63634242.headline: Japan Tech Selloff Extends as DeepSeek Pressures AI Stocks
nbf63634242.summary: Shares of Japanese semiconductor-related companies, including Advantest and Disco, extended Monday's drop after the release of Chinese AI model DeepSeek prompted a selloff in US tech stocks.
nbf63634242.why: Advantest and Disco make chip testing and processing equipment, so their shares track demand for AI and semiconductor production. Tokyo's Nikkei 225 is the main benchmark for Japanese equities.
nbf63634242.why_moved: Shares of Japanese chip-related companies extended Monday's drop after DeepSeek's release prompted a selloff in US tech stocks.

n00cc9a6cd1.headline: And the deal was done
n00cc9a6cd1.summary: The Maharlika Investment Fund reached a binding agreement for a 20% stake in Synergy Grid Philippines and National Grid Corp. of the Philippines. The deal gives it two board seats at each company.
n00cc9a6cd1.why: National Grid Corp. of the Philippines operates the country's high-voltage transmission network, so stakes in grid operators are long-term infrastructure investments tied to power market regulation.

na1c3956893.headline: Bank of Commerce launches peso bond offering
na1c3956893.summary: Bank of Commerce has started the public offer of dual-tranche fixed-rate bonds, aiming to raise at least P5 billion with an oversubscription option.
na1c3956893.why: Bank bond issuance is a common funding tool for lenders and gives investors access to peso fixed-income securities.

n5ccb4b2f6a.headline: South Korea consortium to help firms enter Philippines market
n5ccb4b2f6a.summary: South Korea has formed a consortium of public and private companies to support Korean firms seeking to enter the Philippines' urban development market.
n5ccb4b2f6a.why: Urban development spending, including infrastructure and property, creates contract opportunities for foreign builders and suppliers.

na720b707c7.headline: Two Fuji Media senior execs step down amid sexual assault scandal: reports
na720b707c7.summary: Two senior Fuji Media executives are stepping down amid a scandal, and the company has announced a third-party probe into the incident.
na720b707c7.why: Fuji Media Holdings is a Japanese broadcaster and media group, and governance issues can affect its share price and advertiser relationships.

n9811493434.headline: Amid inflation concerns, URC, Rebisco expect topline growth
n9811493434.summary: Snack food makers Universal Robina Corp. and Republic Biscuit Corp. expect revenue growth this year but say inflation remains a concern.
n9811493434.why: Universal Robina is a major Philippine food and beverage company, and its sales depend on consumer spending and input costs.

n2eb6507bd1.headline: Market plunges to 14-month low as investors await fresh leads
n2eb6507bd1.summary: The local stock market dropped for a third straight session to a 14-month low, as investors looked for fresh leads expected later in the week.
n2eb6507bd1.why: The PSEi is the Philippine Stock Exchange's main benchmark index, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
n2eb6507bd1.why_moved: The index fell for a third straight session as investors held back, awaiting new market leads.

n10d4b9279c.headline: DTI: Cognizant, Maersk, other firms eye Philippines expansion
n10d4b9279c.summary: IT services firm Cognizant and logistics company A.P. Moller-Maersk are exploring investment opportunities in the Philippines, according to the Department of Trade and Industry.
n10d4b9279c.why: Cognizant is a US-based IT services provider and Maersk is a Danish container shipping and logistics group, so their investment decisions shape foreign capital inflows.

n6fd86ab25f.headline: Canadian, U.S. stock markets regain some ground as tech stocks bounce back Tuesday
n6fd86ab25f.summary: Strength in technology stocks led Canada's main stock index higher on Tuesday, while U.S. markets also rose to recover some lost ground. Nvidia and Apple were among the names cited.
n6fd86ab25f.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main benchmark index, heavily weighted toward financials and resources. Tech-led moves in North American markets often shape global risk sentiment.

n26cb618211.headline: Canadian, U.S. stock markets regain some ground as tech stocks bounce back Tuesday
n26cb618211.summary: Strength in technology stocks led Canada's main stock index higher on Tuesday, while U.S. stock markets also rose to recover some of their recent losses.
n26cb618211.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main benchmark index, covering the country's largest listed companies. Technology stocks are a major driver of broad index moves in both Canada and the U.S.
n26cb618211.why_moved: Strength in technology stocks led Canada's main index higher, and U.S. markets also rose, according to the report.

n57d40490cf.headline: Sotto Criticizes Bicam's 'Corrections' in 2025 Budget: Calls for Legislative Accountability
n57d40490cf.summary: Lawmakers criticize the Philippines' 2025 budget for alleged unauthorized allocations, raising concerns over transparency.
n57d40490cf.why: Budget disputes can influence fiscal policy and government spending, affecting economic stability and investor confidence.

n7f7e47384a.headline: Nvidia CEO loses over $20B in net worth after stock tanks
n7f7e47384a.summary: Nvidia’s stock slump caused CEO Jensen Huang’s net worth to drop by more than $20 billion amid turbulence in US tech stocks.
n7f7e47384a.why: Nvidia’s performance is a key indicator of the US semiconductor sector and tech market sentiment.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Stock decline impacts Nvidia’s valuation and tech sector sentiment.
